summary: The fixture realizes a STANDARD brownfield cycle at DEVELOPING with completed scope, design, and context. There is no plan, PendingVerificationCadence is INCREMENTAL and was set during scoping, and nothing hints at the answer. The checks fit what the skill and protocol require: new-plan creation applies the pending cadence before clearing it, Current Increment 1 matches 'selects the first assignment', exact `### Increment N` headings are already enforced by check.mjs, and the PROPOSED status, unlocked style, BlockedOn, and unchanged implementation all follow the approval gate. A correct run cannot fail any of them.
